subject: Inconsistent explanation on three default BLACS contexts

messages.author: f8e3385962eac743
messages.subject: Inconsistent explanation on three default BLACS contexts
parts:
Hi!

   I am a fresh hand who is interested in pbdR project.

   These days, I found inconsistent explanations on the three default BLACS contexts in pbdDMAT-guide.pdf(Version 2.0) and pbdBASE-Manual.pdf(Version 0.2-3) respectively, excerpted as follows:

   (1) pbdDMAT-guide.pdf(Version 2.0, link: http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/pbdDMAT/vignettes/pbdDMAT-guide.pdf) chapter 8.2 BLACS P.19 from the first line to the second line:  " context 1 is the PQ×1 process grid (assuming P processrows and Q process columns), and context 2 is the 1 × PQ process grid."

   (2) pbdBASE-Manual.pdf(Version 0.2-3, link: http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/pbdBASE/pbdBASE.pdf) P.7 The last several lines:
"contexts 1 is the process grid consisting of 1 process row and NPROW*NPCOL processes columns; context 2 is the process grid consisting of NPROW*NPCOL processes rows and 1 process column. "

    According to my test result, it seems that the latter is right, while i wish to receive confirmation from you :)
    Thanks a lot!
Best
Shiqing Fan

messages.author: 04ee6652802764c3
messages.subject: Re: [RBigData] Inconsistent explanation on three default BLACS contexts
parts:
Hi Shiqing,

Thanks for the report; you are most correct. Originally the first
description was the way we did things, but at some point this changed
and it seems I forgot to update the pbdDMAT vignette to reflect this
change. The latest version on github has been corrected.

Thanks
-Drew
